m: उप-घात m. (fr. उप-√ हन्, q.v.), a stroke, hurt, violation

a: उपघातः — 1 A stroke, injury, insult; Ms. 2. 179; Y. 2. 256. --2 Destruction, ruin. --3 Touch, contact (with an intention to hurt). --4 Personal violence, assault. --5 Disease, sickness. --6 Sin.
